title: Opportunistic analysis of CT examinations for the detection of atrioventricular valve regurgitation
summary: This retrospective study analyzes existing chest CT scans and echocardiography reports. The aim is to identify patients with atrioventricular valve regurgitation using an automated segmentation model. The study investigates whether CT scans originally performed for other clinical purposes can also be used to detect valvular heart disease.

interventions.name:
AV valve insufficiency risk assessment with an opportunistic analysis of CT
examinations of the thorax using an automated segmentation model.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with non-contrast or contrast-enhanced chest CT
- Available echocardiography performed within ≤ 30 days of the CT
- Examination performed at LMU University Hospital Munich between 01/01/2015 and 01/01/2025
Exclusion criteria:
- Inadequate image quality of CT scan
- Missing or incomplete echocardiography report
- Time interval between CT and echocardiography > 30 days
